_doc: The one canonical source of the multiplicative unit-conversion factors (declared unit -> SI). Read by open_fdd/nf/units.py, open_fdd/units/convert.py and open_fdd/parity/imperial.py; scripts/nf/build_unit_factors.py writes the same numbers into the generated block of nf-app/static/units.js and checks that the ingest aliases in units.json carry them. These are the NF ingest values: the ingest table is what converts native values, so everything else uses it. Edit here, then run: python scripts/nf/build_unit_factors.py
